`final class AlAudioSource`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IAudioSource`](/reference/bridges/iaudiosource/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.openal` · **Module:** `base-openal` · **Source:** [AlAudioSource.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/openal/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/openal/AlAudioSource.java)

A source of OpenAL that streams the samples of a video through a queue of buffers.

## Description

Every call does nothing while no OpenAL context is current; when the context changed, the source creates its OpenAL objects again.

## Learn more

- [Streaming sources](/build/base-modules/openal/#streaming-sources)

<a id="AlAudioSource-constructor"></a>

### AlAudioSource

`AlAudioSource(AlAudioBridge bridge, int sampleRate, int channels)` 

Creates a source of the bridge for that sample rate and channel count; [`AlAudioBridge.createSource`](/reference/base-openal/alaudiobridge/#AlAudioBridge-method-createSource) calls it.

<a id="AlAudioSource-method-write"></a>

### write

`void write(short[] samples)` 

Mixes the samples down to stereo when they have more than two channels, fills a processed or a new buffer with them and queues it; plays again when the source ran dry while playing.

<a id="AlAudioSource-method-getBufferedSamples"></a>

### getBufferedSamples

`int getBufferedSamples()` 

Returns the number of queued samples that OpenAL has not played yet, or `0` without a context.

<a id="AlAudioSource-method-sync"></a>

### sync

`boolean sync()` 

Follows the current context and sends the mapped gain to OpenAL when it changed; returns `false` when no context is current.

<a id="AlAudioSource-method-isPlaying"></a>

### isPlaying

`boolean isPlaying()` 

If `true`, the source was asked to play and was not paused or stopped since.
